label: Image
description: Holds a picture you already have and feeds it into the workflow: a concept sketch, a reference photo, a texture. Pick a file, or paste an Asset Library id.

inputs.name: in
inputs.label: Image Override
inputs.description: File path, asset id or data URI that replaces the configured image at runtime.

outputs.name: image
outputs.label: Image
outputs.description: The picture as an image asset. Wire it into Generate 3D Model, Analyze Image, AI Verify, Texture and so on.

outputs.name: path
outputs.label: File Path
outputs.description: Local path of the image file.

outputs.name: error
outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error message if the image could not be loaded.
